stem: Quick check — Explain how Terraform sources modules. Which practice is correct?

choices.text: Leave hourly resources running overnight without teardown
Treat budget alerts as a hard spend stop that deletes resources
Apply the objective directly: Explain how Terraform sources modules
Ignore least privilege and use the root user for speed

rationale: Option A aligns with the published objective wording. B violates root/MFA guidance. C ignores teardown. D misstates AWS Budgets behavior (alerts do not stop spend).
